repo.cumulative.py:
"""Running totals over parcels."""


def running_grams(parcels):
    """Return the running total of grams after each parcel, in order."""
    out = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(parcels) - 1):
        total += parcels[i].grams
        out.append(total)
    return out


def final_grams(parcels):
    """Return the total grams of all parcels, or 0 when there are none."""
    totals = running_grams(parcels)
    return totals[-1] if totals else 0
